label: Flask
depicts: Round bottom flask with a narrow neck and one horizontal fill line
use_when: Use when the interface wants a round bottom lab flask with a visible fill line inside the bowl.
avoid_when: Do not use for the triangular flask or tall beaker when the lower body should stay circular.

label: Locked Folder
depicts: Folder outline with a top tab and one keyhole in the middle
use_when: Use when the interface wants a closed folder with a centered keyhole mark on the front.
avoid_when: Do not use for the folder with separate padlock when the lock should hang at the lower right.

label: Locked Folder
depicts: Open side folder outline with a small padlock hanging at lower right
use_when: Use when the interface wants a folder outline paired with a separate padlock icon at the corner.
avoid_when: Do not use for the keyhole folder when the lock should be integrated into the folder face.

label: Full Screen
depicts: Four corner crop marks forming an open square frame with centered space inside
use_when: Use when the interface wants fullscreen or crop corners shown as four separate corner marks.
avoid_when: Do not use for the outward arrows icon when diagonal arrowheads should be visible.

label: Full Screen
depicts: Two diagonal arrow marks pointing outward toward upper right and lower left corners
use_when: Use when the interface wants outward expansion shown with two diagonal arrows rather than corner brackets.
avoid_when: Do not use for the corner frame icon when the shape should stay bracket based with no arrowheads.
